services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Enjoy a sunset on the water! Duration Three hours About Put a perfect ending on the day with a three-hour sail at sunset. Cruising times for Sunset Cruises on Seabird vary through the season to match the three hours before sunset; 6:00 to 9:00 p.m. May to July, 5:00 to 8:00 p.m. in August, and 3:00 to 6:00 p.m. in September and October. Choose an itinerary, or have Captain Chip suggest one. The final course will be set by the Captain according to weather, tides, and sailing conditions. Bring your favorite food and beverages, or arrange catering from local providers. services.name: Quick Cruise
services.desc: Come experience Fenwick, Old Saybrook; or Essex, Connecticut by boat! Duration One hour About We’re happy to help you organize a Unique Outing Plan. Seabird can take you to a destination, cruise around the area, anchor so you can go for a swim, or dock and have you go ashore for lunch or shopping. Another Custom Cruise option is to sail to a location where we drop you off to spend the day ashore. You can return later by ferry, Uber or Lyft, or have Seabird take you back. We can also schedule to pick you up a day or more after drop-off. Included We provide ice, water and basic serving items (paper plates, napkins, utensils) – you supply any food or beverages (including alcoholic beverages)
